config.frozen_note: pre-registered; do not change on the basis of 2019-2025 results. Implementation bugs are documented and the affected analysis re-run.

inherits.primary_feature: shrunk_feature from the CORRECTED Phase 4 pipeline (season_to_date window)
inherits.target_eligibility: Phase 3/4 rules -- per-game min opportunities; require full horizon; same season; never impute missing with zero

candidate_selection.rule: phase4 shrinkage_status == SHRINKAGE_ADDS_VALUE AND appears in a matchup_definition below

matchup_definitions.name: pass_game_epa
matchup_definitions.interpretation: value of a passing offense's per-dropback efficiency may depend on the opposing defense's ability to suppress it

matchup_definitions.name: pass_game_success
matchup_definitions.interpretation: passing success rate vs defensive passing success-rate allowed

matchup_definitions.name: rush_game_epa
matchup_definitions.interpretation: rushing efficiency vs run-defence efficiency allowed

matchup_definitions.name: rush_game_success
matchup_definitions.interpretation: rushing success rate vs run-defence success allowed

matchup_definitions.name: overall_epa
matchup_definitions.interpretation: overall offensive EPA/play vs overall defensive EPA/play allowed

matchup_definitions.name: overall_success
matchup_definitions.interpretation: overall offensive success rate vs defensive success rate allowed

matchup_definitions.name: early_down_epa
matchup_definitions.interpretation: early-down offensive EPA vs early-down defensive EPA allowed

matchup_definitions.name: explosive_pass
matchup_definitions.interpretation: explosive-pass rate vs explosive-pass rate allowed

matchup_definitions.name: explosive_rush
matchup_definitions.interpretation: explosive-rush rate vs explosive-rush rate allowed (off is SHRINKAGE_ADDS_VALUE; def is a Phase-3 NOT_RANK_PERSISTENT metric -- flagged)

matchup_definitions.name: protection_vs_rush_sack
matchup_definitions.interpretation: sack rate allowed by the protection unit vs sack rate generated by the pass rush

matchup_definitions.name: protection_vs_rush_hit
matchup_definitions.interpretation: QB-hit rate allowed vs QB-hit rate generated

matchup_definitions.name: qb_vs_pass_defense_epa
matchup_definitions.interpretation: a QB's per-dropback EPA vs the opposing pass defence's EPA/dropback allowed

matchup_definitions.name: qb_vs_pass_defense_success
matchup_definitions.interpretation: a QB's dropback success rate vs pass-defence success-rate allowed

deferred_matchups.name: receiving_vs_coverage
deferred_matchups.reason: no defensible separation/coverage-quality mapping in the available data (Phase 0/2); team_offense pass metrics already cover the team-level receiving game

config.target_definition: Team A's realised off_metric over the next `horizon` eligible games starting at the target game (Phase 3 target construction)

models.M0_league_mean: predict baseline_league (the Phase 3 as-of 3-completed-season league mean of the target metric)
models.M4_interaction_centered: Y ~ 1 + A_c + B_c + A_c*B_c ; A_c = A - mean_A(train), B_c = B - mean_B(train)  [PREFERRED interaction form]
models.M4_interaction_raw: Y ~ 1 + A + B + A*B  [reported alongside; not the status form]

relative_features_tested: A_minus_B = A - B  (fit as Y ~ 1 + A_minus_B) -- reported as a sensitivity only

randomized_opposing_unit.method: within each training fold, permute B across rows (break the A<->B pairing); refit M4; predict on the REAL test rows

randomized_matchup_pairing.method: permute B across ALL rows within season (break the true off/def pairing, preserve marginals); full walk-forward

negative_controls.future_row_poison: inject a fabricated future game; assert every earlier feature and prediction is byte-identical (Phase 3/4 canary extended)

multiple_comparison.n_tests: all matchup_definitions x {H2, H4} for the centered interaction
multiple_comparison.p_value: one-sided bootstrap: fraction of resamples with interaction_skill <= 0

matchup_interaction_adds_value_requires: real interaction_skill exceeds the randomized-matchup-pairing mean by >= economic_floor_interaction_skill
status_rules.matchup_additive_only_when: skill(M3 vs M1) CI lo > 0 and point >= economic_floor_additive_skill at both horizons, but interaction fails
status_rules.unit_only_when: skill(M1 vs M0 league) CI lo > 0 at both horizons, but M3 does not beat M1
status_rules.no_incremental_matchup_value_when: M1 does not beat the league mean, or nothing beyond it adds value

config.phase_success_criterion: Systematic evidence that matchup interactions add reliable OOS predictive value = more than one matchup with MATCHUP_INTERACTION_ADDS_VALUE, stable across seasons and horizons, controls clean. A null result ("insufficient evidence") is a valid, useful outcome and must not be optimised away.
